# [Human] Review the X04 promotion dossier

## Execution contract

Task key: `H798-X04`.
Issue: #1085.
Scope: X04. Milestone: H. Completion position: 406.
Owner: human. Human tasks retain H ownership and occur at their own prerequisite position.
Requirements: H09

Planned task; required outputs remain pending until verified.

## Dependencies and required inputs

This is the sole controlling whole-task predecessor list. Require the actual versioned artifact or exact scoped human receipt; issue closure is insufficient.
- [#799](https://github.com/Pillar-Interactive/pillar/issues/799) ([Human] Publish the feature complete main release)

### Conditional and action-specific input predicates

- expansion_activation: [#799](https://github.com/Pillar-Interactive/pillar/issues/799) ([Human] Publish the feature complete main release). Branch X04 activates only after main release and independently verified owner permission, exact source/reference/hardware/budget access and included claim-specific qualification. Inactive requires an independent authorized scope receipt; declined/deferred leaves required scope blocked.

Inactive requires a separately verified owner-authorized scope disposition. Declined, deferred, missing, stale or wrong-scope evidence remains blocked. Alternative rows are independent.

### Artifact-specific input contracts

- #1080, #1084, #1081 produce the actual claim-specific evidence for P63/P63s/P65/P66 source/job/fabric and actual GPU field attribution. Retrieve each exact artifact/version/hash and original source-gate lineage. The reviewer supplies a documented independent reading of those records and conflict/authority declaration.
- A qualified owner may perform a claim review where the source gate permits it; independently generated oracle/reference evidence remains mandatory. This does not substitute self-review for the separately required independent main security assessment in #798.
- #1079 produces a versioned P64 method and exact supplied currency/rate/time/population evidence, separating allocated cost, storage wait and qualified causal job delay. The accountable owner decides retained/replacement P64 claim fields; #1081 supplies actual field attribution, not financial authority.
All future outputs above remain required/pending until actually produced and retrieved. Record the producer issue, artifact path or URI, immutable version/hash, provenance and verification result. Existing code anchors establish current behavior only, not completion of these planned outputs.

## Documentation and allocation gate

Governing documentation: merged PR https://github.com/Pillar-Interactive/pillar/pull/1206. Use the immutable reviewed documentation commit 723e0f91b515b0208730b8564398f55c51ab35b7 and verify each exact producer artifact before implementation. The merge supplies planning/reference files, not the future implementation or qualification outputs named by this task.

## Summary
Independently review the exact X04 candidate claim/profile matrix before any expansion claim is public.

## Exact bounded question or action
Does the named qualified reviewer approve, decline or defer each exact X04 claim/profile row in the actual candidate dossier?

## Human authority and execution boundary
Human owner: the actual asset/account/data/contract/release owner or their explicitly appointed qualified reviewer for this scope. Verify their authority rather than inferring it from a display name, repository access or issue closure. Agents may prepare the packet and independently authorized evidence; they cannot invent a human decision, participant, physical handling, elapsed exposure, invoice or review. Account/credential changes, purchases, agreements, destructive operations, installations, external communication and publication require their own applicable authorization. This documentation draft authorizes none of those actions now. Public tags/releases/packages and source publication remain human-only.

## Allowed and excluded scope
Allowed: only the exact subject, finite operation/data/profile scope and producer evidence named above.
Human execution/evidence only, bound to one exact X04 profile and candidate. No invented users, exposure, acknowledgments, payments or public claims. Agents may prepare authorized instruments, but actual people, source permission and field outcomes are human records.
Out of scope: other future profiles, blanket claim approval, purchases or deployments, and public publication.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Review P63/P65/P66 GPU/job/fabric and actual field attribution against unchanged source-ledger numeric gates, both P48 denominators where applicable, actual exposure and stated source limits.
- [ ] Retain real security findings and open high/critical blockers. Named firmware attribution requires the applicable real 30-day coordinated disclosure.
- [ ] Approve/decline/defer each claim/profile separately; one successful row does not pass another or require unrelated profiles as an unconditional AND. Preserve all actual missing/failed/unknown fields and both P48 denominators where applicable.
- [ ] Keep open high/critical security findings blocking the affected claim. Any named public firmware attribution requires its applicable actual reviewed 30-day coordinated-disclosure record.
- [ ] The receipt is eligibility for this exact claim only, never public publication, equipment operation, source access, contract or future-version approval.
- [ ] Record a separate P64 retained-or-explicit-replacement decision for each method/currency/rate/time/population/causal-dollar claim. Public storage-caused dollars require independently qualified dependency/attribution evidence, permitted cost inputs and all applicable gates; an allocation arithmetic fixture or ≥85% attribution figure alone is insufficient.

## Subject and durable decision receipt
Subject kind: claim_review. Bind the exact versioned subject and real evidence described above; binary qualification binds an actual produced candidate digest.
Use the proposed pillar-human-decision/v1 envelope, with this real owning issue number and exact question. Record subject_kind; exact profile/policy/protocol/artifact version and applicable content digest; accountable decision-maker identity and authority basis; independence/conflicts where required; timezone-bearing decision time; one status (approved, declined or deferred); selected option/parameters only for approval; rationale; real producer/evidence locators, versions and hashes; observed versus simulated and measured versus modeled labels; alternatives; unmet preconditions; permitted scope and exclusions; each consumer predicate; retained source gates/numbers; release effect; revisit trigger; and previous verified receipt locator/hash when superseding. Inventory receipts identify the actual physical profile and reproducible inventory evidence; a nonexistent candidate binary digest is not required.
Before collection or commitment, inspect visibility and use a redacted record where needed. Publish the receipt as an actual dated owning-issue comment or a commit-pinned/versioned tracked artifact that intended reviewers can retrieve. Read it back and record its actual permanent locator and content hash. Never fabricate a comment permalink, treat a branch-tip path/scratch file/bare issue URL as a receipt, or put secrets/private participant content in the issue. A new decision supersedes rather than erases the earlier record. Until a verified record exists, this draft names a required future output only.
Approved enables only the exact action/evidence slice and only after separate technical, permission, budget and release conditions pass. Declined records refusal and blocks that branch; it approves neither an alternative nor release-scope removal. Deferred records the missing condition and revisit trigger, and leaves the consumer blocked. Pending is not a receipt. Closing this issue has no approval or qualification meaning.
#811 is the proposed receipt-envelope/dossier validator owner. Schema validity alone cannot establish human permission: the approval workflow must independently verify the actual authorized actor, source/provenance, exact decision content, permanent locator, signature/account evidence where available, permitted readers and non-superseded scope. A valid-looking object, agent-written assertion or copied third-party instruction cannot grant authority.

## Retained source and numerical gates
The following actual consumer-source gates are retained verbatim. They apply only to their named claim/profile; permission is not their pass. Any replacement requires its own explicit authority and evidence.
From #1080:
P63/P63s/P64/P65/P66: named permitted source/mode feasibility PASS precedes attribution; per-mount p50–p99.9 and bytes retain sample validity and cgroup/job identity privacy. At most 1% of one core at 2 GB/s and at most 0.5% added PyTorch step. P65 uses at least 64 GPUs, identifies a 20%-degraded node within 30 minutes, at most 1 false positive per 1,000 node-days with exposure/intervals, independent checkpoint/rank/layer reference and no framework modifications. P66 has source-specific mlx5 RoCE/InfiniBand semantics without UFM; no generic Ethernet-PFC interpretation on native IB or per-I/O GDS attribution. Keep allocated cost, idleness, storage wait and job delay separate. Marketed GPU-starvation additionally requires at least 85% field attribution in 3 independent environments plus all stricter route gates.
From #1080:
P48 mechanism qualification: at least 8 faults plus healthy controls and two-fault cases, at least 20 repetitions, at least 30% held out; at least 90% correct across both all eligible cases and eligible conclusive cases, at most 5% confidently wrong in both populations, at most 25% inconclusive among all eligible cases, and at least 95% scoped negative controls. Report all counts, low-confidence wrong cases, confidence intervals and unsupported/inapplicable populations separately. The 90% overall floor is not weakened by the 25% inconclusive ceiling. p95 answer is within 5 minutes of eligible evidence. Small or correlated corpora are not population guarantees.

## Explicit consumer unblock predicate
No existing executable successor is entitled to publish from closure. A subsequent separately authorized X04 publication may use only approved exact claim/profile rows after every retained terminal gate independently passes. Declined/deferred/unreviewed rows remain unqualified; main #799 remains separate.
For every consumer, missing, wrong-scope, inaccessible, stale, superseded, declined or deferred receipt keeps the affected predicate blocked. A matching approved permission never manufactures field exposure or claim qualification.

## Testing and independent verification
Recompute retained counts, denominators, exposure, versions, permissions and severity/fix evidence; reject stale/synthetic/inaccessible records. Verify actual authority provenance independently of JSON schema validity.
Exercise approved, declined, deferred, closed-without-receipt, wrong actor, wrong profile/version/consumer, expired/revoked permission, missing/inaccessible evidence, hash mismatch and superseded receipt cases. Verify actual human authority/provenance outside schema validation. Reviewers must be able to reconstruct the permitted action and remaining blockers from the redacted durable records. No product tests, live operations or physical/field campaign were run in preparing this body.

## Preserved main, expansion, privacy and rights boundaries
The feature-complete main release retains its approved supported-platform list and all included terminal gates. Model and browser components are optional to install/use; core diagnosis, ordinary native facts and retained report access must work when absent. Included optional capabilities still require enabled and absent qualification. Decline/defer never silently deletes scope. Native framework/shared-core/runtime/store choices are engineering decisions unless they introduce a separate unapproved commitment.
Preserve settled local 30-day default/90-day cap/1 GiB history, 10-minute/256 MiB/72-hour raw limits and all stricter source/field/derivative constraints. Preserve actually granted legacy/sold/free/source rights. An account is required to start the 30-day Local trial. The question about actual legacy customers/grants and remaining purchase/activation operating details stays unresolved. No current source access, sharing, hardware operation or hosted retention promise follows from the roadmap.
